hooks.name: The Contrarian
hooks.template: Stop using {tool}. Here's what {experts} use instead.
hooks.example: Stop using ChatGPT. Here's what AI researchers use instead.

hooks.name: The Secret
hooks.template: {company} doesn't want you to know about this {feature}.
hooks.example: OpenAI doesn't want you to know about this hidden feature.

hooks.name: Just Discovered
hooks.template: I just discovered a {adjective} AI {thing} that can {benefit}.
hooks.example: I just discovered a free AI tool that can clone your voice in 10 seconds.

hooks.name: This AI Will
hooks.template: This AI will {dramatic_outcome} in {timeframe}.
hooks.example: This AI will replace 90% of graphic designers in 2 years.

hooks.name: Breaking News
hooks.template: BREAKING: {company} just {action} and it changes everything.
hooks.example: BREAKING: Google just released Gemini 2.0 and it changes everything.

hooks.name: Free Alternative
hooks.template: Why pay for {paid_tool} when this free AI does it better?
hooks.example: Why pay for Midjourney when this free AI does it better?

hooks.name: Few People Know
hooks.template: Only {percentage} of people know about this AI {thing}.
hooks.example: Only 2% of people know about this AI trick in ChatGPT.

hooks.name: The Money Hook
hooks.template: I made ${amount} in {timeframe} using nothing but AI. Here's how.
hooks.example: I made $5,000 in one week using nothing but AI. Here's how.

hooks.name: The Big Mistake
hooks.template: The biggest mistake you're making with {tool} right now.
hooks.example: The biggest mistake you're making with ChatGPT right now.

hooks.name: Before/After
hooks.template: What used to take {old_time} now takes {new_time} with AI.
hooks.example: What used to take 3 hours now takes 30 seconds with AI.

hooks.name: The Numbered List
hooks.template: {number} AI tools that will {benefit} (#{number} is insane).
hooks.example: 7 AI tools that will 10x your productivity (#5 is insane).

hooks.name: The Career Threat
hooks.template: If you're a {job_title}, this AI should terrify you.
hooks.example: If you're a copywriter, this AI should terrify you.

hooks.name: Boss Doesn't Know
hooks.template: I automated my entire {job_task} with AI. My boss has no idea.
hooks.example: I automated my entire email workflow with AI. My boss has no idea.

hooks.name: Timeline Urgency
hooks.template: In {timeframe}, {prediction}. Here's how to prepare.
hooks.example: In 6 months, AI will make this skill obsolete. Here's how to prepare.

hooks.name: Simple Tutorial
hooks.template: How to {benefit} using AI in {timeframe} (step by step).
hooks.example: How to build a website using AI in 5 minutes (step by step).

hooks.name: The Showdown
hooks.template: I tested {tool_a} vs {tool_b}. The winner surprised me.
hooks.example: I tested GPT-4 vs Claude 3. The winner surprised me.

hooks.name: One Prompt Wonder
hooks.template: This single prompt replaced my {amount} {tool/person}.
hooks.example: This single prompt replaced my $5,000/month copywriter.

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.template: WARNING: {thing} is about to {consequence}. Here's proof.
hooks.example: WARNING: AI job displacement is about to accelerate. Here's proof.

hooks.name: Insider Info
hooks.template: I spoke to someone inside {company}. What they told me is wild.
hooks.example: I spoke to someone inside OpenAI. What they told me is wild.

hooks.name: The Underrated
hooks.template: The most underrated AI {thing} that nobody talks about.
hooks.example: The most underrated AI tool that nobody talks about.

hooks.name: Age Relative
hooks.template: If you're over {age} and not using AI for {task}, you're falling behind.
hooks.example: If you're over 30 and not using AI for your job, you're falling behind.

hooks.name: POV Hook
hooks.template: POV: You discover an AI that {amazing_capability}.
hooks.example: POV: You discover an AI that writes code better than senior developers.

hooks.name: Massive Update
hooks.template: {tool} just dropped a MASSIVE update. Here's what's new.
hooks.example: ChatGPT just dropped a MASSIVE update. Here's what's new.

hooks.name: Overnight Success
hooks.template: This AI went from unknown to {metric} overnight. Here's why.
hooks.example: This AI went from unknown to 10 million users overnight. Here's why.

hooks.name: Delete This
hooks.template: Delete {current_tool} and use this instead. Thank me later.
hooks.example: Delete ChatGPT and use this instead. Thank me later.

hooks.name: Unpopular Opinion
hooks.template: Unpopular opinion: {hot_take_about_ai}.
hooks.example: Unpopular opinion: AI prompt engineering is not a real skill.

hooks.name: Authority Quote
hooks.template: {authority_figure} just said {quote} about AI. They're {right/wrong}.
hooks.example: Elon Musk just said AI will surpass humans by 2026. He's actually right.

hooks.name: First To Know
hooks.template: You're about to be one of the first people to see this AI {thing}.
hooks.example: You're about to be one of the first people to see this AI breakthrough.

hooks.name: Zero to Hero
hooks.template: I went from {starting_point} to {achievement} using only AI in {time}.
hooks.example: I went from zero coding knowledge to launching a SaaS using only AI in 48 hours.

hooks.name: What If
hooks.template: What if I told you AI can {unbelievable_capability} right now?
hooks.example: What if I told you AI can generate a full movie from a single sentence right now?

hooks.name: The Leak
hooks.template: {company}'s next AI just leaked and it's {adjective}.
hooks.example: Google's next AI just leaked and it's absolutely terrifying.

hooks.name: Future Regret
hooks.template: In {timeframe}, you'll regret not learning {thing} today.
hooks.example: In 12 months, you'll regret not learning AI automation today.

hooks.name: The Real Reason
hooks.template: The real reason {entity} {action} has nothing to do with {obvious_reason}.
hooks.example: The real reason Sam Altman fired those researchers has nothing to do with safety.
